title: 1943 yil: 17 yoshli Kamprad Ikea kompaniyasini ochgan

scenes.text: Biznes boshlash uchun yoshing kichikmi? Bu hikoyani eshit.
Shvetsiyalik Ingvar Kamprad bolaligida qo'shnilarga gugurt sotardi.
1943 yilda, 17 yoshida, u IKEA kompaniyasini ro'yxatdan o'tkazdi.
Nom uning ismi, fermasi va qishlog'i bosh harflaridan olingan.
Avval ruchka va hamyonlar, keyin mebel sotdi.
Katta ish kichik savdodan boshlanishi mumkin.
Sen nimani tanlaysan: kichik boshlashnimi yoki kutishnimi?

description: Ingvar Kamprad 1943 yilda, 17 yoshida, IKEA kompaniyasini ro'yxatdan o'tkazgan. Bolaligida gugurt sotgan, keyin ruchka va hamyon, so'ng mebel. Katta ish kichik savdodan boshlanishi mumkin.
source: IKEA official history (https://www.ikea.com/global/en/our-business/how-we-work/story-of-ikea/ ; https://www.ikea.com/us/en/this-is-ikea/about-us/our-heritage-pubde78e100/: founded 1943 at 17, registered 28 July 1943, pens, wallets, picture frames, furniture from 1948; name from Ingvar Kamprad, Elmtaryd, Agunnaryd); Encyclopaedia Britannica: https://www.britannica.com/money/Ingvar-Kamprad ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ingvar_Kamprad (matches from age 5)
